name: Ojutai
description: Ojutai is the dragonlord of the Jeskai on Tarkir, a dragon teacher revered by the Jeskai and remembered as Narset's mentor.

summary.text: Ojutai is the dragonlord of the Jeskai on Tarkir, a dragon teacher revered by the Jeskai and remembered as Narset's mentor.

bio.text: Ojutai's brood merged with Silumgar's and flew to Dirgur, where Shu Yun knelt and offered his life to spare the Jeskai, and Ojutai froze him to death.

citations.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.
"Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

bio.text: He declared the Jeskai no more, ordered every ghostfire warrior killed, and had the names of the clans erased.

citations.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

bio.text: In the changed timeline he ruled Jeskai territory, with Taigam presiding at his sanctuary and saying nothing is higher than Ojutai.

citations.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

bio.text: He taught Narset and named her Master at fifteen, the youngest he had ever named, though she later learned he had led the attack on the khans' summit and was branded a heretic by his order.

citations.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.
"The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.
"Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

bio.text: In the Chronicle of Bolas, his purge destroyed records, and his broodling sentenced Tae Jin to die by ice for sacrilege.

bio.text: In the later Dragonstorm story he is the late dragonlord whom Narset remembers as her teacher, and Taigam led a coup against him.

citations.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.
"Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

status.text: As of the latest story, Ojutai is remembered only in the past, as the former Jeskai dragonlord whom Narset recalls as her teacher and against whom Taigam led a coup.

citations.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 2: Omens" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Khan Reyhan is killed when Ojutai, Silumgar and their broods attack the meeting of khans, leaving Daghatar's people under Dromoka as survivors.
timeline.quote: Ojutai , Silumgar and their broods attacked the meeting, killing her

citation.text: "Abzan Houses", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojutai has every ghostfire Jeskai warrior executed after taking over the Jeskai.
timeline.quote: Ojutai ordered the execution of every ghostfire Jeskai warrior

citation.text: "Dragon", section "Dragon Broods". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun summons the khans to Dirgur Stronghold, but Tasigur has betrayed them to the dragon broods; the Jeskai are subjugated and Shu Yun murdered.
timeline.quote: The ensuing battle ended with the utter subjugation of the Jeskai, the murder of Shu Yun

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Jeskai are reorganized into a new clan headed by Ojutai and his brood.
timeline.quote: The Jeskai were reorganized into a new Clan headed by Ojutai and his brood

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun is killed by Ojutai in exchange for the lives of his clan members.
timeline.quote: He was killed by Ojutai in exchange for the lives of his clan members.

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "Khans". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojutai takes over the Jeskai by attacking the khans' meeting and orders execution of every ghostfire warrior after Shu Yun's surrender.
timeline.quote: Ojutai ordered the execution of every Jeskai ghostfire warrior

citation.text: "Ojutai", section "Current timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tasigur betrays the khans' meeting at Dirgur stronghold; Reyhan is killed and Shu Yun and the Ghostfire initiates give their lives.
timeline.quote: Tasigur betrays the location to the dragonlords.

citation.text: "Tarkir/Timeline", section "Khanfall". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Over millennia, Ugin's magic coalesced into dragon tempests that birthed five broods, each led by a dominant dragon revered by a clan.
timeline.quote: Over the millennia, the spirit dragon Ugin's magic coalesced into powerful storms on his native plane of Tarkir.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Fate Reforged". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Jan 2015.

timeline.summary: In the new timeline, Ojutai notices young Narset and takes her on as a student.
timeline.quote: so she was taken on as a student

citation.text: "Narset", section "New timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Narset admits her discovery to Ojutai, who gives her his blessing to keep seeking knowledge.
timeline.quote: gave her his blessings and encouraged her to continue seeking knowledge and enlightenment

citation.text: "Narset", section "New timeline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Bells announce Silumgar's brood and Ojutai's brood, which merge and fly together toward Dirgur.
timeline.quote: Out over the water, the two massive flights of dragons raced toward each other, crashed together…and merged

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Shu Yun kneels before Ojutai and offers his life to spare the Jeskai; Ojutai freezes him to death.
timeline.quote: The khan of the Jeskai fell.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Ojutai declares through his aven translator that the Jeskai are no more, orders every ghostfire warrior killed, and commands Quan to erase the names of the clans.
timeline.quote: As of this day, there are no more clans. There are no more khans.

citation.text: "Khanfall" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Sarkhan learns that the dragon Ojutai rules the Jeskai and follows word of Narset to the Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
timeline.quote: He followed word of her name up and up, ever closer to Ojutai's roost.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

timeline.summary: Free outside, Narset runs along the river and hears Ojutai's lesson across the distance, and asks to be his student; he nods.
timeline.quote: I want to be your student," she said. "Please, let me be your student."

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: For three years Narset trains under Ojutai from afar by the riverbank.
timeline.quote: Over the next three years, Narset studied, trained, and practiced under the Great Teacher from afar.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Dragonspeaker Ishai invites Narset to study at Dragon's Eye Sanctuary.
timeline.quote: To study under the Great Teacher.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: At fifteen, Narset defeats Taigam in a practice match and is named Master by Ojutai, the youngest he has ever named.
timeline.quote: At fifteen, she was the youngest master Ojutai had ever named.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Atop the summit, Narset feels trapped by the sense that there is nothing more to learn and is unable to thank Ojutai.
timeline.quote: And just like that she was trapped.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: The scrolls contradict Ojutai's teaching by speaking of khans and dragons before him.
timeline.quote: And from what the scrolls said, it seemed that there had been dragons before Ojutai.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Taigam catches Narset and threatens to report her for blasphemy, but she blasts past him.
timeline.quote: Then let him!" Narset erupted with power, blasting past Taigam and ignoring his screams.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: In the looted archive beneath Dirgur, Narset reads the last scroll about the khans' summit and discovers Ojutai led the attack on them, which also reveals Sarkhan.
timeline.quote: One of those dragons had been Ojutai.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Years later, by the river bend, Ojutai asks Narset what she has learned, and she tells him she has learned the truth.
timeline.quote: I have learned the truth," she whispered.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: Narset thanks Ojutai and lets go, walking away from Tarkir.
timeline.quote: Her words were carried away on the winds of Tarkir as she let go.

citation.text: "The Great Teacher's Student" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 4 Mar 2015.

timeline.summary: The Khanfall: each khan falls and their clans with them; five dragon clans rise under the dragonlords.
timeline.quote: one by one, each of the ancient humanoid khans fell, and their clans fell with them

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The dragons turn on each other and allow humanoids to support them, forming five dragon-led clans.
timeline.quote: After the khans were defeated, the dragons turned their attentions to each other.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset gains Ojutai's personal notice as a child and is taken on as a student.
timeline.quote: Ojutai recognized hers as a mind with the potential for nearly limitless growth, so she was taken on as a student.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset grows restless and begins to doubt that Ojutai knows all the answers.
timeline.quote: she started to question whether or not Ojutai truly knew all the answers to the questions of life

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset becomes a master and secretly explores the Ojutai sanctuaries for the forbidden past, ignoring Taigam's warning.
timeline.quote: Her peer, Taigam, warned her of the danger in seeking out knowledge without the dragonlord's permission, but Narset saw no harm in research.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Narset discovers that Tarkir was once ruled by khans and learns of the spirit dragon from whom all dragons were formed.
timeline.quote: Narset also learned of a powerful spirit dragon from whom all dragons were formed.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: In Tarkir's new timeline, Ojutai and his brood conquer Jeskai lands and many djinn submit to dragon worship; after the Stormnexus Ritual, many leave the Way.
timeline.quote: In the new timeline, Jeskai lands were conquered by the dragonlord Ojutai and his brood, and many djinn submitted to his teachings of dragon worship.

citation.text: "Djinn", section "Tarkir". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojutai has history rewritten and punishes deviation as heresy.
timeline.quote: declaring himself ruler and founder of the clan

citation.text: "Ojutai", section "Clan Ojutai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojutai spares Narset after she finds the original clans.
timeline.quote: allowed her to live after she discovered the existence of the original clans

citation.text: "Ojutai", section "Clan Ojutai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ojutai accepts Shu Yun's surrender, has Jeskai ghostfire warriors executed, and rewrites Jeskai records.
timeline.quote: Ojutai ordered the execution of every ghostfire Jeskai warrior.

citation.text: "Tarkir", section "Broods of the Dragonlords". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Dragons assault Dirgur Stronghold, Tasigur betrays the khans, Shu Yun offers his life to Ojutai, and Reyhan dies helping Yasova and Alesha escape; the clans fall.
timeline.quote: Reyhan dies during the fighting to secure an escape for Yasova and Alesha

citation.text: "The Story of Tarkir Block". Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 29 Apr 2015.

timeline.summary: Ishai gains autonomy and authority as Ojutai's attendant.
timeline.quote: Ishai's word carries the full authority of Ojutai

citation.work: It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!
citation.text: "It's Time to Talk Commander (2016 Edition)!" by Magic Creative Team. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 26 Oct 2016.

timeline.summary: Yasova's party sees an Ojutai dragon hunting on the high plateau, and Yasova decides to avoid it on the way to Ugin's grave.
timeline.quote: I want to reach Ugin's grave without tangling with that dragon.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin explains his master's dream and that Ojutai destroyed records but the Spirit Dragon's story survives by oral tradition.
timeline.quote: He wants to destroy our memory of the past, and of our ancestors

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: An Ojutai broodling appears and its aven interpreter sentences Tae Jin to die by ice for sacrilege.
timeline.quote: Tae Jin, by the command of the Great Teacher, you are accused of the crime of sacrilege and sentenced to die by ice.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

timeline.summary: Tae Jin explains that his mother was a scribe of Shu Yun who survived Ojutai's purge and that his master taught him the ghostfire blade.
timeline.quote: She survived Ojutai's purge and dedicated herself to saving what she could of the history and knowledge of the Jeskai Way.

citation.work: Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery
citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: Whispers of Treachery" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Jul 2018.

timeline.summary: The invasion weakens Ojutai's forces, and hidden Jeskai archives spread, strengthening the rebellion.
timeline.quote: This shook the foundation of the dragonlord's power and allowed the rebellion to gain more traction.

citation.text: "Jeskai Way", section "Revival of the Jeskai". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Zurgo approaches Ojutai and the dragonlord agrees to cooperate.
timeline.quote: With the dragons' numbers decimated by the invaders, Ojutai agreed.

citation.text: "Ojutai", section "Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The ritual summons five spirit dragons and the dragonlords are defeated and swallowed by the storm.
timeline.quote: the dragonlords were defeated and seemingly swallowed up by the massive storm

citation.text: "Ojutai", section "Defeat". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The troupe opens its show, and a performer is suddenly wearing a mask of Ojutai that Narset sees in her nightmares.
timeline.quote: Recognition jolted through Narset.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Patrons from different clans quarrel over which rebellion leader was the real hero, while illusions of the dragonlords roar out of the smoke.
timeline.quote: snake-headed Silumgar, Atarka with her crown of antlers, spined Kolaghan, Dromoka shining like the sun, and of course, feathered Ojutai

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset remembers her years as Ojutai's favored student and admits that in saving Tarkir she lost her dragon.
timeline.quote: In saving Tarkir, Narset lost her dragon.

citation.work: Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones
citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: The storm falls silent and they find a massive ancient temple that Narset does not recognize from any records.
timeline.quote: There is a temple in the heart of the storms,

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 5: Recursion" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 12 Mar 2025.

timeline.summary: Narset fights the dragon flock, redirecting their momentum, and recovers her inner center.
timeline.quote: Narset found what she had lost: her center

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 7: Return" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 17 Mar 2025.

relations.note: He presides at Ojutai's sanctuary, saying nothing is higher than Ojutai.
relations.quote: There is nothing higher except Ojutai himself.

citation.text: "A Tarkir of Dragons" by Kimberly J. Kreines. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Feb 2015.

relations.quote: Ojutai's dragonspeaker is talking to me!

relations.quote: The truth of how he came to dominate the clan that bears his name has been lost in the mists of history.

citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

citation.work: Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1
citation.text: "Planeswalker's Guide to Dragons of Tarkir, Part 1". Uncharted Realms, Wizards of the Coast, 11 Mar 2015. Archived by the Internet Archive.

relations.quote: You're not…some enforcer for the dragonlord, here to punish my heresy?

citation.text: "Unbroken and Unbowed" by Kelly Digges. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 22 Apr 2015.

citation.text: "Chronicle of Bolas: The First Lesson" by Kate Elliott. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 20 Jun 2018.

citation.text: "Tarkir: Dragonstorm | Episode 1: Stories and Their Bones " by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 3 Mar 2025.

relations.quote: Certainly, he would not have led a coup against him.
